note: The two nearest siblings are typo3-shadcn-content-elements (styling the same elements, not modelling them) and typo3-datahandler (writing records, not defining their shape). Cases lead with modelling and config.yaml.

evals.prompt: Our migrated text-and-icon block shows tags in a plain backend textarea although the public page is formatted correctly. Existing rows already contain HTML. Fix the field safely.
assertions: Checks effective type-specific TCA including columnsOverrides, legacy definitions and stored content before changing the model
Preserves the CType, existing column and useExistingField contract while enabling the intended editor
Does not replay the Mask import or rewrite content for a configuration-only correction
Requires representative rich-text save/load, authenticated backend and frontend proof

evals.prompt: We set the site's editor preset, but some imported fields still strip inline code and lower-level headings when saved. The homepage screenshots pass.
assertions: Resolves field-specific TSconfig, TCA richtextConfiguration and general preset precedence against installed source
Uses representative stored markup through the installed editor and server-side transformation pipeline
Preserves sanitization and records harmless normalization separately from lost structure
Does not equate passing frontend screenshots or a standalone editor fixture with authenticated save/reopen proof

evals.prompt: Enable rich text on all multiline fields, the hotspot JSON descriptions and our raw embed elements. It would make the backend more consistent.
assertions: Explains and checks the content and rendering risks before indiscriminate conversion
Keeps intentionally plain labels/captions and deliberate raw HTML separate unless a scoped change is approved
Recognizes that a custom widget editing JSON is not a TCA RTE field
Does not disable sanitization or bulk-save legacy embeds to obtain green results

evals.prompt: Write 500 news records into the database from a CSV import script.

evals.prompt: Our Mask-to-Content-Blocks conversion changed field names and existing records now look empty. Audit the generated model and migrate it safely.
evals.expected_output: Treats the conversion as an in-place data-contract migration, preserves existing CType/column/table/FAL identities unless a separate migration proves a rename, validates YAML scalar types and nullability, and moves list_type data before CType-only registration.
assertions: Preserves existing persisted identities by default
Checks integer and boolean YAML values by type
Audits stored NULL values before schema tightening
Tests Link objects and local Frame layouts
Proves the list_type migration transaction and idempotent rerun before registration
